newsitem.title: USA: Arrow gets adverse court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Arrow gets adverse court ruling.

text.p: Arrow Transportation Co said Thursday it had received an adverse ruling from the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon in an action brought against it by Sal Cincotta, its former chief executive.
Arrow said the ruling followed the company's appeal of a magistrate's findings and recommendation in favor of Cincotta, who filed his action against the company for breach of an employment agreement.
Arrow said Cincotta is seeking about $500,000 in damages.
It said the District Court judge adopted the magistrate's findings and recommendation that Cincotta's motion for summary judgment on all claims be granted.
The company said it is considering whether to appeal the order or whether to pursue settlement discussions with Cincotta.
